Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications for Video Endoscopy System for Pediatrics (Infant to adolescent age g roup patients) The system comprises of: 1. Video Processor & LED Light Source 2. Paediatric Video Gastroscope 3. Adult Video Gastroscope 4. Paediatric Colonovideoscope 5. Medical Grade colour Monitor. 6. System Trolley 7. Hardware & Software (latest laptop, Image grabbing software, colour printer) for report generation 8. CO2 Insufflator & Flushing Pump 9. Almirah for storing of equipments 10. Accessories

1). Video Processor & Light Source: · The Video Processor should have an integrated/separate light source with 4 or more LED’s Spectrum tech nology. It is preferable to have Amber LED to improve red colour reproduction in White-Light Imaging and i mprove deep vessel visibility and visibility of deep vessels. · Should have real-time optical enhancement technology like narrow band imaging (NBI)/blue light imaging (BLI)-linked color imaging (LCI)/I-SAN OE to determine potential histology and confirm lateral extent for all i ndications. · Should have the technology for identifying bleeding points and underlining deep vessels during therapeut ic procedures such as red dichromatic imaging or any other similar technology for same purpose. · Should have texture/structural enhancement technology for optimization of the structure, color tone and brightness of the mucosal surface for early cancer detection. · System should have facility of extended depth of focus (EDOF) or similar technology. · Video Processor should have a digital output for 4K imaging and should contain electronics for clear visibility of near and far objects. · Provision of automatic IRIS control and white balance free function. · Equipped with automatic halving of light brightness when the scope is kept idle for more time, so that it m akes the endoscopic room more comfortable for patients and medical staff. 2). Paediatric Video Gastroscope with 2.2 mm channel: · Should have real-time optical chrome endoscopy imaging like NBI/BLI-LCI/I Scan OE. · Should have high definition scope with built in HDTV compatible CCD and with 4k processor. · Should have close observation of the mucosal surface (3mm or less). · Distal End Outer Diameter: 5.8 mm or Less · Insertion Tube Outer Diameter: 5.9 mm or Less · Field of view: 140 Degrees

· Depth of view: 3 mm – 100 mm · Tip Angulation: Up – 210 Degrees or more, Down: 90 Degrees or more, Right and Left: 100 degree or mor e · Instrument Channel: 2.2 mm or more · Compatible image enhancement and Should be compatible with electrocautery. · Fully immersible in water and should have waterproof one touch connector. 3). Adult Video Gastroscope: · Should have real-time optical enhancement technology with forward direction of view. · Should have narrow band image (NBI/BLI/LCI/i-SCAN OE and high definition scope with built in HDTV comp atible CCD / compatible CMOS and with 4k processor. · Should have close observation of the mucosal surface (3mm or less). · Distal End Outer Diameter: 9.9 mm or Less · Insertion Tube Outer Diameter: 9.8 mm or Less · Field of view: 140 Degrees · Depth of view: 2 mm – 100 mm · Tip Angulation: Up – 210 Degrees or more, Down: 90 Degrees or more, Right and Left : 100 degree or mor e · Instrument Channel: 2.8 mm or more · Should have dedicated water jet channel. · Automatic scope identification with compatible scope.

· Fully immersible in water and should have waterproof one touch connector. · Should be supplied with compatible grasping forceps and biopsy forceps 5 quantity each. 4). Paediatric Colonovideoscope: · Should have real-time optical chromo endoscopy imaging like NBI/BLI-LCI/I Scan OE and high definition sc ope with built in HDTV compatible CCD. · Should have user controlled High Force Transmission (HFT)/Advance Force Transmission, Passive bending (PB)/ adaptive bending and Variable Stiffness/gradual stiffness or similar technology. · Inbuilt scope identification memory chip for monitor display of scope’s model no , serial no, and white bal ance memory. · Auxiliary water jet for mucosal dissection. · Should have high resolution CCD/CMOS. · Should have close observation of the mucosal surface (4mm or less). · Distal End Outer Diameter: 9.8 mm or Less · Insertion Tube Outer Diameter: 10.5 mm or Less · Field of view: 140 Degrees or more. · Should have direction of view of forward viewing. · Depth of view: 2 mm – 100 mm or better. · Tip Angulation: Up – 210 Degrees or more, Down: 180 Degrees or more, Right and Left: 160 degree or mo re · Should have working length of 1680 mm or more. · Instrument Channel: 3.2 mm or more · Should have dedicated water jet channel. · Fully immersible in water and should have waterproof one touch connector.

6). Medical Grade Monitor from same make with following specifications: 32 Inch with LED backlit Medical Grade monitor with 4K UHD resolution from same make for better v isualization leading to early detection of pathology and effective treatment. · Should be compatible to route 4K/HD video signals. Should have Multiple display modes including picture-in-picture (PIP) and picture-out-picture (POP) d isplay modes. · Should have clone output function to duplicate the 4k/HD video signals as displayed on the screen, includi ng PIP/POP to a second monitor, or recording device. · Certified from IEC 60-601-1 7). System Trolley: · Space to accommodate all equipment. · Should have a scope hanger. · Should have inbuilt transformer. · Should be from same OEM ,self madeand brochure should be provided along. · Based on Castor wheel locking facility. 8). Hardware & Software (latest laptop, Image grabbing software, Printer ) for report generati on Computer System with UPS & Printer Latest computer system (i-7 processor or better, 1TB or more Hard Disk with 2 TB external HDD ,16 GB RAM or more ) with UPS with appropriate rating. 19 “ or more LCD/LED monitor with mouse and multimedia keyboard Medical grade software to record and edit high quality video and images. Color Laser Printer. Image/Video Recording Software High Definition, high quality, image, and video capture Should be supplied with Foot Switch for still and video recording Should be able to capture images, videos or both simultaneously Pause and Resume function while recording. Should have multiple templates for reporting. 9). Flushing Pump & CO2 Insufflator: · Should be supplied with same make CO2 insufflator (imported) and flushing pump from same make with f oot switch.

10). Almirah (Cupboard) for storing of equipment: · Cabinet with capacity to hold 5 or more endoscopes with lockable holders. · Should have HEPA filters with antibacterial inner and outer construction. 11). Accessories: (should be from same principal company or reputed make). · UGI Biopsy Forceps Reusable – 10 nos. · Grasping Forceps Reusable (Rat Tooth type) – 10 nos. · Grasping Forceps Reusable (Alligator Jaws type, Reusable) – 10 nos. · Sclerotherapy Needle Reusable (24 G size) – 10 nos. · Roth net – 5 · LGI Biopsy Forceps (Reusable) – 5 nos. · Polypectomy Snare (Reusable) – 5 nos. · Splinting tube for Balloon Enteroscope – 10 nos. · CRE balloon inflation device with balloon dilator of sizes starting from 5 mm to 18 mm diameter with guid e wire appropriate to use. · One set of savary guillard dialator · Leakage testing units -3 No 12). Maintenance Clause: · Spares and consumables, and accessories to be supplied for 10 years of the principal. · Required civil work for installation should be taken care by company. · Software of all the equipment to be the latest and should be available for at least next 10 yea rs free of cost if gets corrupted and same should be replaced and upgraded free of cost with an affidavit. · Spares and accessories to be defined in a complete list of each and should be of the principal · Should be covered under five years warranty and five years CMC and loaner should be provid ed if any equipment or spare part goes to workshop for repair to keep services ongoing. · Technical staff person to be trained for handling of equipment, sterilisation and storing. · Comprehensive training for staff and support services till complete familiarity with the system. · 4 downtime should not exceed 72 hours and preventive maintenance visits by the service pro vider every two monthly during the warranty and CMC period. · List of important spare parts and accessories with their part number and costing . · Logbook with instructions for daily, weekly, montly and quarterly maintenance checklist. Job d escription of the hospital technician and company service engineer should be clearly spelt out. · Principal supplier/manufacturer should only provide service and should have facility for repairi ng scopes in India. · On site demonstration is must for all the quoted items. · Necessary training of personnel for the use of equipment will be provided by the principal sup plier/manufacturer.
